svg.title: SecondChance on AWS
svg.desc: Deployed AWS architecture of SecondChance as defined in infra/terraform/modules/secondchance: CloudFront with WAF, API Gateway HTTP and WebSocket APIs, Cognito, Lambda functions inside a private VPC without NAT, RDS Proxy and Aurora PostgreSQL, SQS, Step Functions, EventBridge Scheduler, DynamoDB, S3, Bedrock, SES and the cross-cutting security, observability and delivery services.
svg.text: Deployed view of infra/terraform/modules/secondchance · eu-central-1 · every arrow is a call the module's IAM policies allow
JWT check with JWKS in env
JWKS copied to env at apply
Outside the VPC, no data access:
VPC 10.40.0.0/16 · PRIVATE SUBNETS IN 2 AZ · NO IGW · NO NAT
GOVERNED AGENT TOOL PATH · AI PROPOSES, PEOPLE DECIDE
IAM auth end to end · TLS required · pool max 80 %
RLS on every tenant table · DB users app, maintenance, migrator (IAM tokens, no BYPASSRLS)
runs, steps, agent memory · immutable SHA-256 proposals · email outbox · audit
KMS at rest · master secret in Secrets Manager · pilot: reader in the second AZ
VPC ENDPOINTS · interface: sqs · bedrock-runtime · secretsmanager · lambda · states · gateway: s3 · dynamodb
retention 03:15 UTC daily · requeue every 2 min
Aurora master secret · read by λ migrate only
loop: invoke agent-step → wait 30 s on lease
→ continue or succeed · 6 retries per step
GuardDuty malware scan: infected files unreadable
KMS: one CMK with rotation for Aurora, the master secret,
S3 objects, logs, DynamoDB, SNS, ECR and the audit trail
IAM: one role per Lambda family; rds-db:connect to its own
database user only; scheduler invokes retention + requeue only
CloudTrail: multi-region, validated files, S3 object events
GuardDuty + malware scan; jobs parse only clean uploads
CloudWatch Logs: 30 days, KMS, no PII in access logs
Alarms: API 5xx and p95, Lambda errors and throttles, DLQ,
queue age, Step Functions failures, MCP denials, GuardDuty → SNS
X-Ray active tracing on Lambda and Step Functions; OTLP optional
AWS Budgets: account-wide monthly alert (30 / 150 USD)
GitHub Actions 'production' → OIDC → STS → deploy role
with permission boundary (no users, keys or account changes)
Terraform state: S3 + KMS, native S3 locking
ECR: immutable tags, scan on push (api, worker, gateway)
deploy.sh: apply → λ migrate → S3 sync → CloudFront invalidation
Aurora: 0–2 ACU, 1 instance | 0.5–8 ACU, writer + reader
Backups 7 days | 14 days, deletion protection, PITR
Both: same module, same images, eu-central-1

Source: infra/terraform/modules/secondchance (network, edge, identity, compute, data, storage, queues, orchestration, realtime, ai, notifications, observability, detection). Local equivalents: infra/README.md.
